pageCache.text:
Where every child feels safe, proud of who they are and where they come from and is curious and ready for the next challenges in life.
Follow Us On Facebook For All Our Latest News, Events And Announcements
Our School
At Reckleford Infant School and Nursery we aspire for all our children to be ready, resilient and able to keep going. We encourage a love for learning. Children will be proud of who they are and where they come from. We hope all children will be kind, honest and respectful to themselves and others, sharing and celebrating their differences.
Learn what we do
Reckleford Infant School and Nursery builds learning confidence and enquiring minds. Our curriculum is designed to enable children to begin a life-long love of learning through acquiring knowledge and skills across every subject. Our skilled team work hard to ensure that children make excellent progress whilst supporting parents to help their children in their early stage of education. The basis for all our topics is to build aspiration for the future of all our children.
Our Classes
Key Information
Our
Mission & Vision
At Reckleford Infant School and Nursery we aspire for all our children to be ready, resilient and able to keep going. We encourage the children to be curious and have a love for learning. Children will be proud of who they are and where they come from. We hope all children will be kind, honest and respectful to themselves and others, sharing and celebrating their differences.
Upcoming Events
News
Contact Us
From Our Headteacher
"We want every child to be excited by their learning success and proud of their progress. Our aim is to begin every child's life-long love of learning both inside and outside of the classroom and our highly skilled and experienced staff work hard every day to inspire, challenge and have fun with all our children."

"GOOD" SCHOOL
We are incredibly proud to be rated 'Good' by Ofsted across all areas. Our strong curriculum and dedicated staff create a supportive and vibrant environment where our pupils thrive.
We emphasise respect, fairness, and high expectations, which foster both academic success and personal growth. Our leadership and teaching teams are passionate about nurturing a love of learning and promoting positive behaviour.
It's truly rewarding to see our children excited about their education and well-prepared for their future stages. Every day here is filled with enthusiasm and a commitment to excellence!

We provide a robust and engaging curriculum that ensures every child reaches their full academic potential.
Our pupils consistently display positive behavior and attitudes, creating a respectful and supportive school environment.
We focus on the holistic development of our pupils, nurturing their interests, talents, and social skills.
Our strong leadership team is committed to continuous improvement and fostering a culture of excellence.
Our Early Years program offers a nurturing and stimulating environment, laying a solid foundation for lifelong learning.
We have maintained our high standards and continue to build on our strengths, consistently achieving good ratings.

pageCache.pageTitle: About Us - Reckleford Nursery & Infant School
pageCache.text:
About
Reckleford Infant School and Nursery is a school for children ages 2-7. We have three Nursery classrooms; Sunbeams, Raindrops and Rainbows, and 3 school classrooms; Squirrels, Hedgehogs and Badgers. We were delighted to receive ‘Good’ in all areas in our report from Ofsted in 2023 with Ofsted praising the personal and social development opportunities we provide for the children at Reckleford. As well as our lovely classrooms, we also have two large playgrounds; one for Nursery and one for School, a MUGA (multi use games area), an award winning school garden, outside NEST classroom, our Woodland continuous provision room and our ELSA den.
Our Nursery classrooms are:
Sunbeams – age 2Raindrops – age 3Rainbows – PreSchool children age 3 and 4
Our School classrooms are:
Squirrels – ReceptionHedgehogs – Year OneBadgers – Year Two
Our Nursery sessions are:
Breakfast club 8-9amMorning 9-12pmAfternoon 12-3pm
We offer both 15 and 30 hour funded places and places for those families wishing to pay fees.
Please click here for our admission and fees policy
We use our outside NEST classroom for small group work, one to one activities, Nurture time and more! Our ELSA (Emotional Literacy Support Assisant), Mrs Wellman, has a newly developed ELSA Den where children can receive one to one and small group support with their emotional literacy, well-being, mental health and also other quiet interventions such as phonics and Lego Therapy.
Be Ready
Show Respect
Be Resilient
Teaching the Professionals of tomorrow
Our 72-place nursery, the Rainbow Room, is open Monday to Friday during term time, offering flexible sessions to fit your needs:
Nursery children can enjoy either morning or afternoon sessions, or both, providing up to 30 hours of enriching activities and care. In the Rainbow Room, we create a nurturing environment where every child feels safe, inspired, and excited to explore and learn.
Squirrels Class is full of energy and curiosity, our youngest learners start their educational journey here. At Reckleford, we believe in knowing and valuing our differences, respecting each other, and understanding that everyone is important. In the Squirrels Class, we foster a caring, happy, and safe environment where every child feels safe, inspired, and excited to learn and grow.
Hedgehogs Class is our Year 1 class who are always ready to discover and learn new things. We promote a healthy and active lifestyle, encouraging children to reach their full potential. The Hedgehogs Class is a vibrant community where respect, understanding, and a lifelong love of learning are at the core of everything we do.
In Badgers Class, you will find our Year 2 students who are ready to take on new challenges. In the Badgers Class, we emphasise the importance of knowing and valuing our differences, respecting each other, and understanding that everyone is important. We strive to inspire a lifelong love of learning in a supportive and engaging environment.
The Rainbow Room

Yr1 - Hedgehogs

Morning Session: 9:00 am – 12:00 noon
Afternoon Session: 12:00 noon – 3:00 pm
Our HEADTEACHER
We are a small and successful school on the East side of Yeovil, offering places to children from the age of 2 to 7 years. We offer a safe and happy environment where every child is valued, their strengths celebrated and their needs understood and supported. We ensure that families feel welcome and are very much a part of their child's education.
We want every child to be excited by their learning success and proud of their progress. We aim to begin every child's life-long love of learning both inside and outside of the classroom and our highly skilled and experienced staff work hard every day to inspire, challenge and have fun with all our children.
In June 2023 we were, once again, rated as 'Good' in all areas by OFSTED. Our Nursery is led by an experienced teacher and gives every child a fantastic start in developing all the crucial skills for personal development and school readiness. If you haven't visited us yet, please feel free to do so by contacting the school office on
With all best wishes.
Jo Greathead, Headteacher
Testimonials
What Parents are Saying
I can’t sing the praises of this school high enough. Everyday I picked my daughter up from school she was happy and full excitement to tell me all about the amazing things she had been doing during her day. The staff are always happy, professional and put my daughter’s needs first. A great school right in the middle of town that so often gets overlooked for the bigger schools. A small community school, with small class sizes but big ambitions to produce happy, confident kids ready to go onto big school.
Lovely place i worried to death for my son to start school last year but the teachers made it as easy as possible. Lovely ladies they do amazing job there i am so greatful we choose this school they make sure children do learn but also have some fun. Couldnt wish for better school and teachers for my child. Highly recommended.

pageCache.pageTitle: Curriculum Overview - Reckleford Nursery & Infant School
pageCache.text:
A curriculum full of potential
At Reckleford we have designed a curriculum which provides daily opportunities to develop Literacy and Maths skills and maxmise every child's potential to progress. Our curriculum covers all the statutory requirements of the Early Years Framework and Key Stage One, offering exciting learning which covers a wide range of stimulating opportunities to develop children's basic skills, knowledge and understanding of the World. We encourage every child to develop their particular strengths and the opportunity to express themselves, share ideas, explore and ask questions.
Key Aspects of Our Curriculum
Reading at the Heart: We follow the ‘Read, Write Inc.’ scheme from Nursery through the school. This literacy programme teaches letter sounds, reading, and writing. All our staff are trained to deliver the programme, and we help parents support their children’s progress by integrating it into homework tasks.
Values Core to Our Curriculum: Our values of Ready, Respect and Resilience are integral to all experiences offered to our children.
